requirements.description: User explicitly wants a location near public transport. The value is the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71, as required for 'near' expressions of proximity.

The building is to become a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary for the project type. The value is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.
User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. No consumption threshold was requested, so energy_class is used rather than epglnren_ape.
The user explicitly specifies a minimum gross floor area of 850 sqm.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 850 sqm), energy_class (A1-A4, B, C), mobility (>= 71) and education (>= 75), plus a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The requirement tipologia_bene_immobile ('Uffici e assimilabili') was ignored because that column is not in the filterable columns list. No LIMIT is applied.
